service: Agent Discovery lets you search public records for AI agents, tools, skills, and other resources that their publishers have made discoverable.

operations.SearchPublicRecords: Search public agent records across the authoritative + crawler indexes. Hybrid keyword + neural ranking, merged and fused (weighted RRF), with filters, org governance policy, and descriptor-visibility enforcement applied server-side. Public, authenticated (D-1).

ArdErrorCode.base: ARD's error classification (Appendix B). Values are ARD's, uppercase on the wire.

refs.InternalServerException$errorCode: ARD's Appendix B code on the ARD surface, INTERNAL_ERROR.

DescriptorEntry.base: A descriptor slot value (A2A card, MCP server card, skills definition, custom). Content is either inline (data) or a reference (source). additionalData carries nested sub-descriptors (e.g. mcpServer.tools, agentSkillsDefinition.skillMd).

DescriptorMap.base: Keyed descriptor slots (Vestry DescriptorsV2 = Map<String, DescriptorEntry>). A record carries one slot per descriptor type it publishes, and additionalData one per named sub-descriptor, so 32 is well above any real record. A PutRecord over the cap is a 400.

refs.PublicRecord$descriptors: Every PUBLIC descriptor slot the record was published with, as published: each slot's source, inline data, version and nested additionalData, the custom slot included. Absent on a record discovered at a partner source; ARD serves the partner's cards.

DescriptorSource.base: Reference to descriptor content hosted at a URL.

refs.DescriptorSource$fromUrl: The URL that hosts the descriptor content.

DomainName.base: FQDN per RFC-1035/1123, case-insensitive, at least two labels.

Identifier.base: The resolvable identifier value. Discriminated union — exactly one member is set.

InternalServerException.base:
Thrown on an internal defect — a bug or malformed state, not a failed dependency.

⚠️ Deliberately a **permanent** failure. Repeating a request that failed to serialize will fail identically, so treating a 500 as retryable would spin a poison message through redelivery forever instead of letting it reach a dead-letter queue. Dependency failures that *are* worth retrying use `ServiceUnavailableException` and its 503 instead.

ProvenanceLink.base: Lineage of a record (AI Catalog Provenance Link Object), with only its required members.

refs.TrustManifest$provenance: The record's lineage as the contributor states it: how the contributor got the record, and from which source.

ProvenanceRelation.base: A provenance link's relation, in AI Catalog's verb-phrase style (AI Catalog leaves it free text), and the value of an ARD entry's com.amazon.route53.registry.origin extension. The provenance filter on SearchPublicRecords and ARD takes these values or authoritative, discovered and federated, in any case.

PublicRecord.base: A public record returned by search. Only the record's public descriptors are included.

refs.SearchPublicRecordsResponse$records: The records that match the search, most relevant first.

refs.PublicRecord$recordType: The kind of resource the record describes, such as an agent, a tool, or a skill.

SearchFilterExpression.base: SearchPublicRecords' filters: an object of field → {operator: value}, or one $and/$or key holding an array of such objects. A document because a value is a string or an array depending on the operator.

refs.SearchPublicRecordsRequest$filters:
Structured filter narrowing the results, in the grammar of Agent Registry's SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords filters: $eq, $ne and $in on a field, with $and or $or over single-condition objects, never nested. Fields are identifier, domain, recordType, descriptorType, provenance and recordVersion, and identifier also takes $prefix. For example {"recordType": {"$eq": "AGENT"}} or {"$or": [{"recordType": {"$eq": "MCP"}}, {"domain": {"$eq": "acme.com"}}]}.

Limits, the same ones Agent Registry applies: at most 10 conditions, `$in` takes 1-25 values, values are strings of 1-512 characters, and `{}` is invalid. A `document` can't carry `@length`, so the service enforces these and answers a filter past them with a ValidationException, as Agent Registry does.

ThrottlingException.base: Thrown when the caller exceeds a rate/burst limit (D-9). ARD's code for it is RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

TrustManifest.base: One contributor's trust metadata about a record (AI Catalog Trust Manifest Object), with only the members the registry sets. AI Catalog's other members (subject, signature, trustSchema, attestations, extensions) are optional, so each can be added when something sets it.

TrustManifestList.base: Capped like ArdTrustManifestList. AI Catalog sets no count.

refs.PublicRecord$trustManifests: Trust Manifests (AI Catalog Trust Manifest Object), today only the registry's own, contributor did:web:agent-registry.global.api.aws. Its one provenance link says how the registry got the record: relation is publishedFrom for a record its owner published and discoveredFrom for one the registry discovered at a partner source, with sourceId as ProvenanceLink.sourceId describes. The provenance filter takes the same values (see ProvenanceRelation). It's left off when the registry can't name the source: a federatedFrom record until the index carries the peer registry, a discovered record with no source, or a missing or unknown origin. The manifest is unsigned, so it attributes the claim to the registry and doesn't authenticate it.

ValidationException.base:
Thrown when a request fails input validation.

`errorCode` carries ARD's Appendix B code, `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, which ARD's OpenAPI makes a required member of every error body on the ARD surface. The Amazon-shaped and internal surfaces leave it unset.

refs.SearchPublicRecordsResponse$nextToken: The token to pass in a later request to get the next page of results. Absent when there are no more results.

refs.PublicRecord$recordVersion: The record's version string, set by its publisher. Left off when the record has none, for example a discovered record whose source carries no version.

refs.SearchPublicRecordsRequest$searchQuery: Free-text natural-language query (ARD text). Drives semantic + lexical ranking.

trustUri.base: A URI or other identifier in a Trust Manifest: a contributor or a source.

refs.ProvenanceLink$sourceId: The source of the record. Not always a URI. On publishedFrom it's the value of the record's identifier union member, identifier.uri or identifier.domain, unchanged. On discoveredFrom it's the name the registry gave the partner source when it was configured for crawling, not a URL.
refs.TrustManifest$contributor: Absolute URI of the contributor these claims are attributed to.

refs.DescriptorSourceUrl$url: The URL of the externally hosted descriptor content.
